The present hypothesis addresses this level. Rumination is described as a surrogate prediction-error minimization mechanism that arises when registered sympathetic activation finds no causal explanation in the subject's generative model, while both standard routes of resolution-action and prior revision-are structurally unavailable. The key self-maintenance circuit is borrowed from the interoceptive conditioning literature: afferent feedback from the mobilization itself belongs to the same class of visceral signal as the conditioned threat predictor and reconfirms it-a loop documented in the panic spiral in its acute mode and extrapolated here to a chronic, subcatastrophic mode. In this mode, the system iteratively generates internal explanatory representations (confabulations) that temporarily reduce the mismatch but can neither update the predictor nor interrupt the loop. The accumulating outcome of the process is neither resolution nor downregulation, but depletion of cognitive resource alongside persisting activation. The hypothesis is complementary to existing active-inference models of rumination, supplying a physiological grounding for their halting problem, and generates three falsifiable predictions: anti-habituation under active ruminative elaboration, an effect of purely peripheral reduction of afferent feedback, and a dissociation between cognitive fatigue and autonomic tone.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7389598\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "5129c4b0504d93b73448f9e0224a69b4286baa6c082419dd80ce5211ca4cb3c7", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "assumption_challenge", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.2139/ssrn.2089846", "doi:10.2139/ssrn.5409502", "doi:10.4324/9781315247465-13", "doi:10.2139/ssrn.7389598"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.2089846", "https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5409502", "https://doi.org/10.4324/9781315247465-13", "https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7389598"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}
